ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE LICENSE AND SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

Section 1. Grant of License
Vendor grants Customer a non-exclusive, perpetual license to deploy the software on up to 50 server nodes.

Section 2. Service Level Commitments and Penalties
Vendor warrants 99.95% monthly service availability. In the event of Priority 1 outages exceeding 30 minutes,
Customer shall receive a 10% credit against the annual subscription fee.

Section 3. Limitation of Liability and Indemnification Cap
Except for gross negligence or willful misconduct, total aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid in prior 12 months.
